overview: One depends on a specific object's shape and size. The other is an intrinsic property of the material itself.
genZNote: Resistance is about the wire you have. Resistivity is about the material it's made of.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Opposition to current flow offered by a specific conductor (R = V/I).
aspects.valueB: Intrinsic material property relating resistance to a conductor's dimensions (R = ρL/A).

aspects.label: Depends on Shape/Size?
aspects.valueA: Yes — depends on length and cross-sectional area.
aspects.valueB: No — depends only on the material and temperature, not shape or size.
